t: This is Chesham House, a house in Westminster. It was designed by Sir Henry Tanner, who lived from 1849 to 1935. Tanner was a prominent British architect of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, and he worked for His Majesty's Office of Works, the government body responsible for public buildings. That official background is the context for this design. I don't have more detail on the house itself, so take a look at the building and see what you make of it.
